newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: EnergyDirect to pay special dividend.
newsitem.headline: EnergyDirect to pay special dividend.

text.p: EnergyDirect Ltd said on Friday it would pay a special fully imputed dividend on October 1 of five cents per share.
Books close on September 27 and its goes ex on September 30.

The dividend is based on the expected earnings for the six months ended September 30 and is consistent with the valuation and financial forecasts included in the TransAlta NZ Listing Profile mailed to shareholders last month, EDL said.

TransAlta Energy owns 41 percent of EnergyDirect, which is merging with Wellington's Capital Power to form TransAlta NZ. TransAlta Energy owns all of Capital Power and will hold 63 percent of the merged entity.
